review_description: Every aspect of work was top class. Was kept informed and updated all the way through the process. Installation happened on the prescribed date. Quality of the installers was first class. They were very polite and the job site was left neat and tidy. We literally didn't have to do anything as all connections and inspections were organised by the company.Whole process was easy and stress free. Would have no hesitation recommending Crowlz Electrical to family and friends.
